title: The Math That Quietly Keeps You Poor
description:
It is rarely one large mistake. It is a series of small conversions where you trade lasting value for temporary comfort.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: It is rarely one large mistake. It is a series of small conversions where you trade lasting value for temporary comfort.
Subscriptions are the clearest example. A few dollars monthly is designed to be too small for your brain to register as a loss.
Fees work the same way. Interest compounds forward for the lender and against you, on the exact same schedule.
Then there is the convenience trade. Paying to save ten minutes feels trivial until you add up a year of it.
The useful question is not what something costs. It is what it costs per month of your actual life.
Most people do not need to earn dramatically more. They need to stop paying for things they have stopped noticing.
